data.one_liner: Store and query Firestore documents based on geographic location in real time.
data.what_it_does: GeoFlutterFire is a lightweight add-on library for Cloud Firestore that lets you save geographical locations and query documents within a given radius. It uses geohashes to perform queries and returns real-time streams of document snapshots.
use_when: You need real-time location-based queries using Firebase Firestore
You want to filter documents within a specific radius from a center point
avoid_when: You need complex range queries on multiple fields alongside geoqueries
You rely heavily on built-in server-side limit() or orderBy() combined with location filtering
strengths: Real-time streaming of geographic query results
Seamless integration with cloud_firestore and support for `withConverter`
Supports strict mode filtering and nested location fields
weaknesses: Does not support limit() or orderBy() out of the box
Strict mode filtering happens on the client side which may cause unnecessary document reads at large radii
data.setup_notes: Requires a Firebase project with Cloud Firestore set up.
